Deliver [[Kurzick Supplies|supplies]] to the [[Kurzick]] front lines.

== Quest information ==
=== Objectives ===
* Deliver the Kurzick supplies to [[Quartermaster Mikhail]].
 
=== Reward ===
* 2,000 [[Experience]]
* 400 [[Kurzick Faction]]
* 150 [[Gold]]

== Walkthrough ==
After accepting the quest, you will receive a bundle of Kurzick Supplies, which you must carry to Quartermaster Mikhail. Follow the map marker and fight your way through [[Ferndale]]. This quest triggers eight [[Luxon]] spawns along the various paths to [[Lutgardis Conservatory]], though you will only need to encounter a few of them on the way, just dispatch them and go on. Should you drop the bundle along the route, it will [[ping]] the [[compass]] map to remind you to pick it up.

About halfway, you will see [[Mugra Swiftspell]] and some [[Dredge]]. It is possible to sneak past this group without a fight. At the next fork, turn left and immediately right again. On this way you will encounter two groups of [[Warden]]s. Try to lure the second group near where you fought the first group, because next to the second group's [[spawn]] place will also be a Luxon and [[Oni]] [[popup]] location, which can be deadly for your party. When you can [[target]] Quartermaster Mikhail, there is only one popup group of Wardens left (in the narrow corridor) and a group of Luxons right in front of Mikhail. You can just run past both of these and get your quest reward.

== Dialogue ==
=== Initial dialogue ===
; Supplymaster Konrad
: ''"Hmph.  Another outsider who wants our help, eh?  Well, if you want help from the Kurzicks, you'd better be prepared to help us in return.  The Luxons think they can outlast us, but we have enough supplies to last for years to come.  Our problem is getting the supplies to those that need them: the troops on the front lines.  Those Luxon cowards keep attacking our supply caravans, and I can't spare the guards to fend them off.  We need another way to get the supplies to the front, and I'd say you fit the bill.  Deliver these '''supplies''' to '''Quartermaster Mikhail''', and then we'll talk about what help we can offer you in return."''
{{offer dialog
| accept = A delivery? Sure, sounds simple enough.

| ask = Why are you talking to me? Take these '''supplies''' to '''Quartermaster Mikhail''' on the front lines!

:'''Luxon Necromancer:''' ''"Give us the supplies and we might let you live!"''

=== Reward dialogue ===
; Quartermaster Mikhail
: ''"You have proven your worth, outlander. We Kurzicks are in your debt."''

== Notes ==
* You can rush through (using a running build) without fighting; you are not required to kill the Luxon groups. 
* This quest is suited well as a pointer for the way from [[House zu Heltzer]] to [[Lutgardis Conservatory]], since Quartermaster Mikhail stands right in front of the entry to Lutgardis.
* This quest works well with the other Ferndale repeatable quest [[Scouting Ferndale]]. The last group of that quest is not far from the beginning for this one, and the rewards are next to each other just outside Lutgardis Conservatory. Therefore start from Lutgardis, do Scouting Ferndale and finish with this quest.
{{Anomaly|If Lutgardis Conservatory is under Luxon control, the [[Luxon Guard]]s at the resurrection shrine will attack any hostile Luxons.}}
{{bug|Sometimes the Luxon groups will spawn even if this quest is not in your [[Quest Log]], though once you have completed the quest they will not spawn again.}}
